# Check: upstream truncated-text.test.ts

## Upstream file
tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/truncated-text.test.ts

## Subject
TruncatedText component — padded, truncated multi-line rendering.

## Upstream test count (approx)
10

## Behaviors asserted upstream
- pads output lines to exactly match width
- pads output with vertical padding lines to width
- truncates long text and pads to width
- preserves ANSI codes in output and pads correctly
- truncates styled text and adds reset code before ellipsis
- handles text that fits exactly
- handles empty text
- stops at newline and only shows first line
- truncates first line even with newlines in text

## Upstream dependencies
TruncatedText from ../src/components/truncated-text.js; visibleWidth; Chalk

## Upstream notes
TruncatedText(text, paddingX, paddingY). render(width) returns array of lines padded to width. Ellipsis is "...". ANSI reset codes before/after styled text. Vertical padding creates empty lines above and below.

## Candidate Elixir counterpart(s)
- grep apps/octo_pi_tui for truncated_text (components/truncated_text_test.exs if it exists)

## Processing protocol
Same as standard check ticket protocol in epic opi-q5k description. Compliance ticket must list each missing behavior and require a post-implementation re-comparison. Block opi-q5k.1.

comments.text:
# Audit findings

Upstream: tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/truncated-text.test.ts (9 tests)
Upstream impl: tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/src/components/truncated-text.ts (exported from pi-tui)
Upstream usage: tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent uses `TruncatedText` in interactive mode (e.g., status/footer lines that must always fit on one row).

Ours: no `TruncatedText` component. `grep -rn 'TruncatedText\|truncated_text'` in apps/octo_pi_tui returns nothing. Our existing Text/SelectList/Footer each implement their own ad-hoc single-line truncation (see opi-q5k.18 notes).

## MAPPED

None.

## UNMAPPED

All 9 upstream tests:
1. pads output to exactly width with `paddingX=1, paddingY=0` (1 content line)
2. pads with vertical padding (`paddingX=0, paddingY=2` → 5 lines: 2 pad + 1 content + 2 pad)
3. truncates long text and pads to width; stripped output contains `"..."`
4. preserves ANSI codes, pads to exact visible width
5. truncates styled text, `"\e[0m..."` appears before the ellipsis
6. text that fits exactly — no ellipsis
7. empty text — still emits one line padded to width
8. stops at newline — only first line rendered
9. truncates first line even when multiple newlines exist

## Implementation gap

The `TruncatedText` component is missing. It is used by the upstream coding-agent interactive mode (imported alongside Input, Loader, Markdown, etc.). We should port it so anything that needs single-line-always-fits rendering can use a shared ANSI/wide-grapheme-aware implementation instead of re-inventing it per component.

Depends on opi-q5k.31 (WrapAnsi.truncate_to_width) — TruncatedText internally uses truncateToWidth upstream.

## Action

Compliance ticket: implement `OctoPi.TUI.Components.TruncatedText`, add `truncated_text_test.exs` porting all 9 upstream tests.
